basics.name: Sobhan Asasi
basics.label: PhD Researcher, CVSSP, University of Surrey
basics.summary: PhD researcher at the Centre for Vision, Speech and Signal Processing (CVSSP), University of Surrey, supervised by Prof. Richard Bowden. My thesis is on sign language recognition and translation, with a focus on gloss-free translation, motion-level knowledge transfer across sign languages, and transferable sign representations.
